title: Immunohistochemical Staining of Insulin and Glucagon in Human Pancreas Islets
author: Lora Starrs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kv6cw9e
materials: Dilute primary antibodies in diluted stock protein concentrate (diluent prepared from M.O.M. Immunodetection kit).

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin and rehydrate tissue sections before staining.

substeps.instruction: Deparaffinize slides in xylene for 1 min.
Rehydrate through graded ethanol: absolute ethanol (10 dips), 90 % ethanol (10 dips), 70 % ethanol (10 dips).
Wash slides in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Initial PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice in phosphate‑buffered saline.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2 × 2 min in 250 ml PBS.

steps.title: Prepare slides in fresh PBS
steps.instruction: Place sections in fresh buffer and remove excess liquid.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with a tissue.
Encircle each section with a diamond pencil.
Place sections in a clean 250 ml slide container containing fresh PBS.
Wipe away excess PBS around each section with a tissue.
Prepare peroxidase‑block solution: add 10 µl H₂O₂ to 10 ml methanol (3 % H₂O₂ in methanol).
Add 28 µl 18 % (w/v) sodium azide to 5 ml of the 3 % H₂O₂/methanol solution.
Incubate sections in the solution for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer slides to a clean 250 ml slide container of fresh PBS.
Wash slides three times, total duration 10 min.

steps.title: Remove excess PBS
steps.instruction: Dry sections briefly before antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue to remove excess PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply diluted anti‑insulin or anti‑glucagon antibody (or appropriate isotype control).

substeps.instruction: Dilute anti‑insulin mAb (stock ~20 mg/ml) or anti‑glucagon mAb (stock ~31 mg/ml) 1:500 in M.O.M. diluent (or use 40 µg/ml or 62.5 µg/ml mouse IgG κ isotype control, respectively).
Apply 125–150 µl per section and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Transfer slides to PBS container.
Wash 2 × 2 min with PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add biotinylated anti‑mouse IgG from the M.O.M. kit.

substeps.instruction: Dilute secondary biotinylated anti‑mouse IgG 1:250 in M.O.M. kit diluent.
Apply 150 µl per section and incubate 10 min at room temperature.
Wash slides 2 × 2 min with PBS.

steps.title: Apply ABC reagent
steps.instruction: Add Vectastain ABC reagent from the M.O.M. kit.

substeps.instruction: Cover sections with ABC reagent and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Wash slides 3 × 10 min with PBS.

steps.title: Prepare AEC chromogen solution
steps.instruction: Make fresh AEC working solution for color development.

substeps.instruction: Mix 4.75 ml acetate buffer, 0.25 ml AEC stock solution, and 25 µl 3 % H₂O₂.
Filter through a disposable 0.2 µm filter.
Use within 2 h; refrigerate briefly for short‑term storage and protect from light.

steps.title: Develop with AEC solution
steps.instruction: Allow chromogen to develop the stain.

substeps.instruction: Cover sections with AEC solution and incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Wash slides 3 × 10 min with deionized water.

steps.title: Counterstain, wash, and mount
steps.instruction: Apply hematoxylin counterstain, rinse, and coverslip.

substeps.instruction: Lightly counterstain with Gill’s hematoxylin.
Wash in deionized water twice.
Dip briefly (2 sec) twice in ammonium water (100 µl ammonia in 250 ml deionized water).
Wash in deionized water twice (250 ml each).
Coverslip using Glycergel mounting medium.
